context:
Goal: the work goes on now, and you can overrule any coordinator pick.
Problem (goal): the coordinator took these undoable picks on Nov 12, 13:41-13:59 CST without asking you; they stand unless you choose b.
Based on (read): the coordinator's messages to triage at 13:41, 13:44, 13:46 and 13:59 CST.
Departs from: main has no such picks on record — the lanes they govern follow these picks.
home: the roadmap steps each pick names (record branch)

options.gain: Lanes keep moving without waiting on you.
options.how: The copy-check lane ships as one PR, not four, since its reviews ran on the whole. The mail guard fix waits for the wake test (now done, so it is ready). A new step fixes the reviewer model table to run round 1 on Sonnet for guard changes, as you ruled on Nov 10. The narrow-screen page fix stacks on open PR #2347. A new express lane makes fix-check review records readable after two unreadable ones. Eleven more lanes started from triage's sized lists. Undo: the coordinator reverses any one.
options.label: Keep the picks (Recommended)
options.lose: A pick you would have made differently runs until you overrule it.

options.gain: Your choice instead of the coordinator's.
options.how: Say which pick to reverse in the note; the coordinator reverses it.
options.label: Overrule them
options.lose: The lanes those picks govern pause.

title: Six coordinator picks: one-PR copy check, blocked mail guard, round-1 Sonnet fix, page fix base, express review records, lane starts
why: Coordinator picks you could not see before.
